name: One Starcaller Arcane Protection per caster on each recipient (#5167)
contract: Arcane Protection ranks 1-3 share the chain 573343 -> 573344 -> 573345 (spell_ranks, rev_20260903_01) and Greater Arcane Protection 573348 is unranked; no spell_group listed them, so Aura::CanStackWith let the normal and greater versions stay on one recipient (#5167). They share spell group 1143 with stack rule 2 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER): the newest replaces the caster's previous one, while a second Starcaller's still coexists - the same shape as the Templar Gift (1140) group. Only the first rank is listed because SpellMgr::LoadSpellGroups drops any other rank and chains resolve through GetFirstSpellInChain.

steps.label: Greater Arcane Protection from the same caster
It replaced the same caster's Arcane Protection
A second Starcaller gives Arcane Protection
The other caster's Arcane Protection coexists (rule 2, not rule 1)
